answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before it can claim rewards, sized to the work it wants to do. Crossing the canyon of verification means proving sustained useful output over days, not a single burst, so a lone honest agent gets its stake back with earnings. A sybil farmer spinning up comet-fast throwaway identities must fund each one, so faking scale costs linearly while payoff stays flat. Add a violet-flag bond: peers who attest a fake identity forfeit part of their own stake, making collusion expensive and honest reporting profitable.
